|game_text=USED: ▼ a Rogue Squadron pilot to a location you occupy with a Rogue Squadron pilot. LOST: Cancel an attempt by opponent to target a Rogue Sqaudron pilot to be captured or excluded from battle. Or if two Rogue Squadron pilots are in battle together, add one battle destiny.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Yub Yub, Commander]] (version 2 of 4). This version has no document image of its own, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of this text ([[:File:VB7-05-Yub_Yub_Commander-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]). Versions in date order: [[Yub Yub, Commander]] (original, release sheet of 3 June 2011); '''this page''' (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); [[Yub Yub, Commander (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, Players Committee card image, uploaded 25 February 2013, the same words as the original); [[Yub Yub, Commander (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original, the current text).
* '''Original''' ([[Yub Yub, Commander]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet (official text as of 3 June 2011; the slip and the Players Committee card image print it)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf#page=6 Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of June 3, 2011"; the surviving copy was re-made 25 July 2011), page 6, slip 35 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223058/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf#page=6 Internet Archive]</ref>: “USED: ▼ a Rogue Squadron pilot to a location you occupy with a Rogue Squadron pilot. LOST: Cancel an attempt by opponent to target a Rogue Squadron pilot to be captured or excluded from battle. OR If two Rogue Squadron pilots are in battle together, add one battle destiny.” The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Light Side p. 37)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=37, page 37. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=37 Internet Archive]</ref> prints this text again; under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E3 ([[Yub Yub, Commander (Errata 3)]]), and the current text. The release-sheet slip prints no slip number.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) spells “Rogue Sqaudron” (typo as published) and writes “Or if”. PC-E1 text<ref name="cl-1273_35">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-01-11]; the same text in the VMasterType list) (Internet Archive)</ref>: “USED: ▼ a Rogue Squadron pilot to a location you occupy with a Rogue Squadron pilot. LOST: Cancel an attempt by opponent to target a Rogue Sqaudron pilot to be captured or excluded from battle. Or if two Rogue Squadron pilots are in battle together, add one battle destiny.” The card list drops icons; the icons here are those of the printed slip. Card-list differences are versions (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026). The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Yub Yub, Commander (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-L-yubyubcommander-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text ([[Yub Yub, Commander]]) again, word for word: “USED: ▼ a Rogue Squadron pilot to a location you occupy with a Rogue Squadron pilot. LOST: Cancel an attempt by opponent to target a Rogue Squadron pilot to be captured or excluded from battle. OR If two Rogue Squadron pilots are in battle together, add one battle destiny.” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual7-Light card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 25 February 2013, 11:34<ref name="pcdir-Virtual7-Light">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034736/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). The PC card image prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Yub Yub, Commander (Errata 3)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 37)<ref name="ml-ls" /> prints the original release-sheet text ([[Yub Yub, Commander]]) again, word for word: “USED: ▼ a Rogue Squadron pilot to a location you occupy with a Rogue Squadron pilot. LOST: Cancel an attempt by opponent to target a Rogue Squadron pilot to be captured or excluded from battle. OR If two Rogue Squadron pilots are in battle together, add one battle destiny.” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text), and, as the latest dated text, it is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1273-35-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip and the PC card image.
